basics.name: Pablo Olivares Martínez
basics.label: Budding Data Scientist
basics.summary: Budding Data Scientist with a strong foundation in Computer Science and Mathematics. Deeply passionate about leveraging data and AI to solve complex problems and make a meaningful impact. Excel in challenging environments that promote learning, teamwork, and out-of-the-box thinking.

work.name: Santander Bank
work.summary: Selected for the Santander Data Science Talent Program
highlights: Conducted statistical controls for data ingestion processes.
Identified and developed 'successes' features for LLM training model evaluation.
Optimized previous attributes constraints evaluation, achieving a 12x speed improvement.
Assisted in the design of scalable data systems, gaining experience in big data technologies.
Utilized Jira for project management, applying Kanban and Scrum methodologies to enhance workflow efficiency.

projects.name: Topological Data Analysis in CNNs
projects.description: Explored the integration of Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to enhance understanding of CNN data manipulation.
highlights: Applied persistent homology techniques to analyze data structure during CNN processing.
Proposed topological regularization in models like EfficientNet-B0 and DenseNet-121, improving classification accuracy and generalization.
Demonstrated improved knowledge transfer through topological modifications, suggesting new strategies for CNN optimization.

projects.name: Parking Detection in the city of Granada
projects.description: Applied semantic segmentation for urban planning, focusing on parking space detection in Granada using models like PSPNet and DeepLabV3+.
highlights: Achieved 80% F1 Score, enhancing urban mobility plans.

volunteer.summary: Developed and maintained extensive notes in LaTeX for LibreIM, a non-profit organization, focusing on Formal Logic and Topology.
Successfully managed to give lessons in mathematics and basic programming to high school children while maintaining college studies.
Organized charity and environmental tasks including cleaning natural environments, charitable collections to aid minorities, awareness campaigns, and social inclusion activities.
